title: A Two-stage Translation of the Chinese Version Menstrual Distress Questionnaire
brief_summary: This study attempted to do the two-stage design of the translation of the MDQC (Menstrual Distress Questionnaire Form C-Cycle) Chinese version, and to do the validity and reliability test.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. A eumenorrheic healthy woman with a regular menstrual cycle for three months, predictable, and a period between 24-38 days that lasts less than 8 days.
2. No hormonal contraceptives have been used in the past six months.
3. No history of smoking, drinking or drug abuse.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Women with systemic diseases, cardiovascular diseases, liver diseases, kidney diseases, diabetes or thyroid diseases.
2. Taking any medicine due to chronic disease
3. Women with mental illness
study_population: Healthy females aged 20-40 years with regular and predictable menstrual cycles, fluent in speaking, reading, and writing Chinese in Taiwan
